form.label: Quarantine Candidates
form.description: Investigate and Quarantine workloads directly from this dashboard based on detected port scanning and agent tampering

search.query: | tstats `summariesonly` count FROM datamodel=Illumio.Audit BY Audit.pce_fqdn
| tstats `summariesonly` count FROM datamodel=Illumio.Audit WHERE Audit.pce_fqdn=$pce_tok|s$ BY Audit.org_id

table.title: "Quarantine Workload" action in blue will quarantine the source workload (Workload could be a VEN or unmanaged)

search.query: | savedsearch Illumio_PortScan pce_fqdn=$pce_tok$ org_id=$org_id_tok$ ```Look up labels and map them to key:value pairs using illumio_labels_lookup``` | foreach *_href [lookup illumio_workloads_lookup href AS <<FIELD>> OUTPUTNEW labels AS <<MATCHSTR>>_labels | lookup illumio_labels_lookup href AS <<MATCHSTR>>_labels, pce_fqdn, org_id OUTPUT key AS label_key, value AS label_value | eval <<MATCHSTR>>_labels = mvzip(label_key, label_value, ":") | fields - label_key label_value] | fillnull value="-" src_host src_href dest_host dest_href src_labels dest_labels ```Check that the user has the illumio_quarantine_workload role``` | appendcols [| rest splunk_server=local /services/authentication/current-context | eval show_quarantine=if(roles="illumio_quarantine_workload", 1, 0) | table show_quarantine] | filldown show_quarantine ```For quarantine, we only care about internal workloads performing scanning``` | eval show_quarantine = if(show_quarantine=1 AND src_href!="-", 1, 0) | eval workload_href = if(src_href="-", dest_href, src_href) | eval Quarantine = if(show_quarantine=1, "Quarantine Workload", "") | sort _time | table _time, pce_fqdn, org_id, src_ip, src_host, src_labels, dest_ip, dest_host, dest_labels, Quarantine, workload_href | rename pce_fqdn AS PCE, org_id AS "Org ID", src_host AS Source, src_ip AS "Source IP", src_labels AS "Source Labels", dest_host AS Destination, dest_ip AS "Destination IP", dest_labels AS "Destination Labels" | eval Timestamp = strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%Z")

table.title: "Quarantine Workload" action in blue will quarantine a VEN that generated agent.tampering events

search.query: | savedsearch Illumio_Firewall_Tampering | lookup illumio_workloads_lookup ven.href AS ven_href OUTPUTNEW href AS workload_href, labels AS Labels ```Map workload label HREFs to key:value pairs for display``` | lookup illumio_labels_lookup href AS Labels, pce_fqdn, org_id OUTPUT key AS label_key, value AS label_value | eval Labels = mvzip(label_key, label_value, ":") | fields - label_key label_value ```Check that the user has the illumio_quarantine_workload role``` | appendcols [| rest splunk_server=local /services/authentication/current-context | eval show_quarantine=if(roles="illumio_quarantine_workload", 1, 0) | table show_quarantine] | filldown show_quarantine | eval Quarantine = if(show_quarantine=1, "Quarantine Workload", "") | table Timestamp, pce_fqdn, org_id, Labels, workload_hostname, Quarantine, workload_href | search pce_fqdn=$pce_tok$ org_id=$org_id_tok$ | rename workload_hostname AS Hostname, pce_fqdn AS PCE, org_id AS "Org ID"
